text:
Maria: Heads-up — planning an internal broadcast for v1.14.0 tomorrow 10:00 PT. Drafting the short release digest + internal post. Quiet-hours window proposal 09:30-11:30 PT. @Jen (ops) please confirm rollback criteria and pin.
Kevin: Timing works for me. Can we tighten quiet-hours to 09:45-11:00? Infra has a maintenance kick at 11:15.
Anya: Draft snippets below — keep them short, we paste this into #internal. PTAL and copycheck.
Anya: ```
• v1.14.0 — batching heuristics improvements, ~20ms p99 reduction
• Runtime pin: rtd-2026-02-02-build.23 (ensures kernel parity)
• Canary policy: 30m canary, failover to build.22 on errors
• Rollback criteria: >3% client errors for 10m OR sustained latency >2x baseline
```
deploy-bot: deploybot detected: canary job queued for region-us-west in 30m. Tagging release: internal-announce/v1.14.0.
Jen (ops): Acked. Rollback criteria look good. I confirm runtime pin and will standby for manual rollback if canary breaches thresholds. I'll post the pin to the incident tracker: INC-2431.
Kevin: Small wording nit — change 'Runtime pin' -> 'Runtime pin (server-side runtime)' to avoid confusion with models. Otherwise :+1:.
Maria: Updated snippet with Kevin's wording. Final copy below — if no objections by EOD I'll schedule the internal post and pin the release.
Maria: """
Heads-up: v1.14.0 will roll out tomorrow 10:00 PT. Key points:
• Improved batching — lower p99 latencies
• Runtime pin (server-side runtime): rtd-2026-02-02-build.23
• Canary for 30m, auto-fallback to build.22 on regressions
• Rollback if >3% client errors for 10m OR latency >2x baseline
Quiet window: 09:45-11:00 PT. Ops standby: Jen.
If you have urgent concerns please reply here. :loudspeaker:
"""
Anya: Looks clean. :thumbsup:
Jen (ops): I'll be on-call and will post to #incidents if we need rollback. Scheduling OK from ops side.
Maria: Thanks everyone — scheduling internal broadcast for 09:50 PT (post + pin at 09:50, canary kicks 10:00). Will follow up with deploybot cues. :raised_hands:
